hotels.title: Baltimore Luxe Escape on Iconic Recreation Pier
hotels.description: Baltimore's vibrant history and tranquil personality collide in the sophisticated Pendry Baltimore, located in a memorable 1914 property on the iconic Recreation Pier. This luxurious hotel pays homage to the quintessential Baltimore essence with bespoke antique decorations, warm hospitality, and even a whiskey bar named after the 17th-century cannons discovered under the pier - a true place of reimagined tradition.
